item.content:encoded:
Old discussion thread.

Credit to Kondraki for writing the original article, which I rewrote after it dropped to -11.

Minor spoilers? For a certain value of spoilers.
Sphoilersh.
  • The "SCP-625 may not be exposed to other rodents under any circumstances." line is related to the first [DATA EXPUNGED].
  • The "Further, any specimen of SCP-625 that have consumed human flesh on more than one occasion must be terminated. The body may be disposed of in Site 19's incinerator." line is related to the second [DATA EXPUNGED].
  • They are Peter's fears and hallucinations made real. They operate on nightmare logic/biology, not real-life logic/biology. How exactly they became real and how things unfolded from there are up to you.
